BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Crystal Titan!!
Whoa... What the heck is this.\nIt's obviously a Coenubia's nest...
Well, yea.\nWe have to deal with it...
Whoa! It's there! It's there!!\nHey! Are you ready to fight?\nLet's do it!!
Phew, that was tough...\nHm? What are you doing?
Whoa! What?!
He's covered with moss and mushrooms but looks\nlike a researcher...\nIs he the archaeologist?
Huh? Oh, you're a human...\nWell, my name is Arrol. An archaeologist.\nYou came to rescue me? Ah, thank you...
Where's the monster?
What are you asking? We took it down.\nSeriously didn't notice after that battle?
Oh, I'm sorry...\nI become so oblivious to everything when I'm\nobsessed with something...
No way... You didn't notice that mess...?\nYou must be a type of bibliobibuli, right?!\nAren't ya?!
I'm not sure but...\nI just found inscriptions on the ground when\nI got stuck here.
And I was deciphering it all the time...
So, you didn't even try to escape from here,\ndidn't call for help, and you were reading\nthe inscriptions covered with moss and mushrooms...
Idiot! You're just an idiot!!
Huh, why are you upset...
But I found out something great!!
There are many inscriptions that describe about\nthe 12 gods.
So! There could be the ruins of the gods where\nthe gods were living in ancient days being\nisolated from the human world!
The ruins of the gods might be ahead of here!!\nHow exciting, isn't it?!
He's helpless. He's gone crazy...
Anyway, we found him.\nWhy not we go back?
Wait a minute!!\nThere might be a bigger discovery.
So, I wanna keep going!\nIf you say it's dangerous, escort me!!
WHAT?! I'm listening to you patiently you know...?\nIf you keep going like that, I'll hit you with\nmy hammer!
You told him that he should go back to Nov Saterica\nand cleanse up himself, and investigate again after\nreporting the discoveries to Kunon...
...Hmm, right. All my supplies and expenses for\ninvestigation are from Kunon so...\nIt's important to report the progress.
Okay. Let's go back to Nov Saterica!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go out!
